summary: Mid-cycle per-model rounding caused multi-line invoice delta and provisional credit hold
description:
Issue summary: Customer reporting a $4,312.57 discrepancy across three invoice line items after they changed reserved capacity and model variant pins mid-billing-window. Impact: Customer billing shows duplicate-looking microbatch line items with fractional token rounding that sum to an unexpected delta. Provisional credit that normally applies during postback reconciliation was withheld pending investigation.

Context: Novus Retail migrated a portion of traffic from mixlm-13b-v1 to redwood/quantized-medium-7b on 2026-03-08 at ~18:40 UTC to reduce cost. They are on a Dedicated contract with hourly reserved capacity. The pricing tier change happened roughly in the middle of the hourly accumulation window which led to blended per-token rates for the same API key. The customer expects the platform to attribute usage to a single effective tier and apply smoothing/rounding consistently; instead the invoice contains three separate lines for similar microbatch events and a withheld provisional credit labeled "auto-reconcile-hold".
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer has Dedicated reserved capacity with hourly aggregation enabled.
2) At T0 (2026-03-08 18:40 UTC) customer changes model pin for route /v1/chat from mixlm-13b-v1 to redwood/quantized-medium-7b and reduces reserved GPUs by 20%.
3) Billing pipeline receives mixed postbacks during the hourly window with both pre-change and post-change tags blended by edge proxies.
4) Aggregator produces per-model microbatch rounding to 2 decimal places and emits three invoice lines instead of a single smoothed line.
5) Reconciler flags the blended window for manual provisional credit hold due to tier ambiguity.
logs: Billing postback sample (2026-03-08T18:41:02Z): {api_key: redacted, model: mixlm-13b-v1, tokens: 1324.7, microbatch: 3, rate_applied: 0.0009}
Billing postback sample (2026-03-08T18:41:15Z): {api_key: redacted, model: redwood/quantized-medium-7b, tokens: 1401.3, microbatch: 4, rate_applied: 0.00075}

Invoice extract lines: 
 - LINE_A: mixlm-13b-v1 microbatch 2026-03-08 18:00-19:00 $2,131.14
 - LINE_B: quantized-medium-7b interleaved microbatch $1,879.23
 - LINE_C: rounding-redistribution adjustment $302.20
 - PROVISIONAL_HOLD: auto-reconcile-hold ($4,312.57)
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 09:30 - Initial triage by billing: confirmed three line items in finalized invoice CSV. Held provisional credit flagged by reconciler due to conflicting tier tags.

2026-03-10 11:10 - Correlated postbacks to edge proxy logs (edge-42). Observed that some postbacks lost 'reserved-tier' tag during resize event; others retained old tag. This created duplicate attribution for same token ranges.
2026-03-10 14:25 - Re-created aggregator run on staging with mixed postback order: reproduces multi-line output due to per-model rounding to cents before merging aggregated buckets.

2026-03-11 08:05 - Finance note: rounding is performed per model per microbatch and then summed; expected behavior is to sum raw token*rate then round. Current implementation introduces per-model rounding noise that is visible when tiers change mid-window.

2026-03-11 13:40 - Hypothesis: two contributing bugs: (A) lost 'reserved-tier' tag on some postbacks during capacity resize; (B) aggregator performs early per-model rounding. Combined yield delta larger than threshold, triggering hold.
comments: Ava Chen (2026-03-10): Logged by customer support after Novus escalation. Customer shared invoice PDF and CSV. They've paused autoscaling changes but need provisional credit applied for immediate cashflow reasons.
Liam Patel (2026-03-10): Investigating. I've pulled relevant postbacks and correlated edge-proxy traces. Noted mix of tier tags in the window. Added billing/owner (finance) to the thread.
Priya Rao - Billing (2026-03-10): Looking into aggregator logic. We currently round at per-model microbatch stage. Finance prefers final-sum rounding. Preparing repro in staging.

SRE (Jamal Ortiz) (2026-03-11): Edge proxy resize event at 2026-03-08T18:40:12Z shows some in-flight postbacks retried without metadata; likely root cause for lost tag. We need to add idempotent tag propagation on retry path.
Novus (Emma Li) (2026-03-11): We appreciate the fast triage. Can you provisionally credit the invoice while you investigate? The amount is blocking their payroll approval.

Liam Patel (2026-03-12): Temporary workaround proposed: apply a one-time manual credit equal to the delta ($4,312.57) and mark for reversal if reconciliation shows otherwise. Awaiting approval from Finance ops.
resolution: Workaround applied: manual provisional credit issued; long-term fix planned.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-12 - Manual Credit: Finance approved a one-time provisional credit of $4,312.57 to Novus Retail's account (internal ledger entry CR-2026-03-135790). Labelled 'provisional-billing-adjustment'.
2026-03-12 - Short-term mitigation: SRE patched edge proxy retry metadata propagation to preserve 'reserved-tier' tag during autoscale operations (hotfix deployed to us-east edge-42 cluster).

2026-03-12 - Long-term fix: Billing team to update aggregator to delay rounding until after summing raw token*rate across models (design doc PR opened). Related GitHub PR: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/421.
Follow-up tasks: create INT ticket to add e2e test covering resizes during billing windows; link SUP-135790 to that internal ticket.
